title: Borrowers made 60% of the debt in reach safe before the November low

numbers.what: The window of the note: four days, from 00:00 UTC on 12 November to the end of 15 November
numbers.source: Base block headers: block 56256122 is the first at 00:00:00 UTC on 12 November, block 57984122 the first on 16 November; Coinbase BTC-USD hourly candles: the lowest low in the hour from 01:00 UTC on 15 November

numbers.what: BTC on Coinbase: the open at 00:00 UTC on 12 November against the lowest hourly low before 16 November
numbers.source: Coinbase Exchange public API, BTC-USD hourly candles

numbers.what: Debt in reach of the fall at the start, nine markets
numbers.source: Morpho Blue on Base, read from a public archive node: every position with debt at block 56256122 (00:00 UTC, 12 November 2026), the market's oracle price at that block, and every Liquidate, Repay and SupplyCollateral event of the market to block 57984121 (23:59:59 UTC, 15 November). In reach: the oracle price fall that makes the position liquidatable, 1 - debt / (collateral x price x LLTV), is smaller than the market's oracle fall
